title: Fiestaware withstands the test of time
text:
Fiestaware withstands the test of time. My grandmother had a set of blue Fiestaware mixing bowls, so in a way, I grew up with the bright colors, durability and classic styling of Homer Laughlin's signature line. Recently, I moved into my first home and was given a set of four heather four-piece place settings. I plan to add on to the collection as more pieces are added in the newest color, heather.

This four-piece set comes with a dinner plate, salad plate, stackable cereal bowls, and a mug in place of the teacup and saucer present in the five-piece place setting. Besides being durable (it's dishwasher, microwave, and oven-safe), lead-free, and coming with a 3-year chip warranty, Fiestaware has been made in the USA since 1936.

The classic Art Deco styling and wide range of coordinates (vases, teapots, trays, candlesticks, spoon rests, salt and pepper shakers) means that it?s fabulously easy to mix and match various colors for an eye-catching effect. The dishes are substantial in weight, and make a striking presentation for any meal. Fiestaware is an excellent investment and the perfect wedding or housewarming gift.
